items: Melt butter and vanilla chips in microwave, stirring at 30-second intervals until smooth.
In a large bowl beat eggs, sugar, and salt at high speed until pale and thick.
Blend melted mixture in with egg mixture. Add vanilla.
Mix in flour until combined and spread in prepared pan.
Bake 35-49 minutes or until toothpick inserted near the center comes clean. Top will be crusty and very light brown.
Cool and top with chocolate frosting.
